questions.prompt: A loan app promises 'no documents, instant cash in 2 minutes'. What does that usually signal?

options.text: A serious red flag—check if the lender is officially registered first
A reliable bank offering faster customer service
options.explanationWrong: Regulated banks and NBFCs must follow RBI KYC checks; skipping them is a warning sign.

options.text: Lower interest rates than normal banks
options.explanationWrong: Predatory instant loan apps hide extreme fees and short repayment traps.

options.text: Zero repayment risk
options.explanationWrong: Unregulated loan apps often charge exorbitant costs and harass borrowers.

questions.explanationCorrect: Legitimate lenders perform proper KYC and disclose full terms. 'No documents' is a major red flag.

questions.prompt: Why should you calculate total repayment before accepting any loan offer?

options.text: Small weekly or monthly figures can hide massive total interest and fees
Calculators automatically negotiate a lower interest rate
options.explanationWrong: Calculators reveal the real cost so you can avoid traps.

options.text: Only to check your credit card PIN
options.explanationWrong: Loan calculators have nothing to do with PINs.

options.text: To bypass RBI lender verification
options.explanationWrong: You should always do both: check total cost AND verify lender registration.

questions.explanationCorrect: Looking only at small per-month numbers hides the full cost. Always check total repayment.

questions.prompt: Who regulates legitimate banks, lenders, and NBFCs in India?

options.text: RBI (Reserve Bank of India)
Any app store listing or five-star review
options.explanationWrong: App store listings and fake reviews do not verify legal lending status.

options.text: The loan app's own customer support chat
Whoever sent the promotional SMS
options.explanationWrong: Promotional texts prove nothing about regulation.

questions.explanationCorrect: Verify whether a lender or partner NBFC is authorised on RBI's official lists before sharing any documents.

questions.prompt: An instant loan app asks for access to your phone Contacts and Photo Gallery. Why is this dangerous?

options.text: Rogue loan apps steal contacts and photos to threaten or blackmail borrowers
Banks need your family photos to calculate interest
options.explanationWrong: Legitimate lenders never need your personal gallery or contact list.

options.text: Granting contacts makes your loan interest-free
options.explanationWrong: App permissions have no effect on legal interest rates.

options.text: It backs up your gallery to RBI servers
options.explanationWrong: RBI does not collect personal phone galleries or contacts.

questions.explanationCorrect: Predatory apps harvest contacts and photos for harassment. Decline the offer and revoke those permissions immediately.

questions.prompt: You spot an unverified lender in an SMS loan link. What is the safest response?

options.text: Decline the offer, revoke any app permissions, and never share OTP or KYC IDs
Upload your Aadhaar and PAN just to check your eligibility limit
options.explanationWrong: Uploading IDs to rogue apps exposes you to identity theft.

options.text: Pay a ₹999 'processing fee' upfront before receiving the loan
options.explanationWrong: Upfront processing fees on random links are classic advance-fee scams.

options.text: Borrow a smaller amount to test the app
options.explanationWrong: Even a tiny loan gives rogue apps leverage to charge fees and harass contacts.

questions.explanationCorrect: If a lender is not verified or asks for invasive permissions, decline cleanly and revoke access.

questions.prompt: What should a transparent, regulated loan offer show you clearly before you accept?

options.text: Principal, annual interest rate, all fees, tenure, and exact total repayment
Only 'Get cash now!' with no repayment schedule
options.explanationWrong: Hiding fees and repayment dates is a hallmark of predatory apps.

options.text: A demand for your UPI PIN upfront
options.explanationWrong: No lender needs your UPI PIN to issue a loan.

options.text: Mandatory access to all your SMS messages and social media
options.explanationWrong: Excessive data scraping is unsafe and unnecessary.

questions.explanationCorrect: Regulated lenders provide a clear Key Fact Statement showing fees, annualised cost, and exact repayment totals.
